headers.//: Vercel already 308s http -> https at the edge, but only after the plaintext request has been made. HSTS closes that first request: once a browser has seen this header it rewrites http:// to https:// itself, before anything leaves the machine. Two years is the usual value. No 'preload' - that submits the domain to a list baked into browser binaries and is slow to undo, which is the wrong commitment for a beta.
